claims.evidence: The accession contains 24 BUB1B RAW files, with 21 cell-derived runs and three HELA_beadsonly controls; all 21 cell-derived files map once.

claims.location: characteristics[cell line] and Cellosaurus fields, rows 1-21
claims.evidence: The paper reports BubR1 IPs from HeLa, HAP1 and RPE1; MaxQuant groups identify each run; the curated lookup gives CVCL_0030, CVCL_Y019 and CVCL_4388. HAP-1 is the EFO label for HAP1. The current Cellosaurus HAP1 record gives original donor age 40Y and BCR-ABL1-positive chronic myelogenous leukemia; the bundled age cache is stale.

claims.location: factor value[Bub1 status] and comment[technical replicate], rows 1-21
claims.value: WT, KO, and KO plus siRNA groups; three technical repeats per group
claims.evidence: MaxQuant Experiment codes distinguish groups; paper Figure 3C identifies three technical repeats of BubR1 purification. Specific siRNA target is not asserted.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[modification parameters], comment[fragment mass tolerance], rows 1-21
claims.value: Trypsin/P, fixed carbamidomethyl C, variable oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetyl, 20 ppm FTMS MS/MS tolerance
claims.evidence: These are directly specified in the deposited BUB1B MaxQuant summary and parameters.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], rows 1-21
claims.value: Q Exactive HF-X DDA HCD at 27 NCE
claims.evidence: The paper AP-MS method specifies these settings; no BUB1B RAW header was locally inspected.
Paper AP-MS method and PRIDE sample protocol specify DTT and CAA.

limitations: The three bead-only BUB1B controls are excluded and documented in PXD012235.BLOCKED.md.
Cellosaurus-derived age, sex and sampling site describe original donor origin, not the current culture.
HAP1 original donor age and disease come from current Cellosaurus CVCL_Y019; RPE1 donor disease is not asserted.
The HELA_KOsiRNA label is preserved as KO plus siRNA, without asserting the specific siRNA target.
